segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Great.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Well, hi, everyone!

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: My name's Jody and I'm one of the four recreation officers here at Rainforest Lodge.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: My job is to make sure that you all have a great stay here with us and go away feeling relaxed and refreshed.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: As you can see, we're literally in the middle of nowhere at the Lodge.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: There are no newspapers or TVs and there's only one phone and that's in the office.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: The Lodge is a complete 'getaway from it all' experience: a place to unwind and appreciate the world without a lot of interruptions and distractions.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: From your cabin balcony you'll find that you can't see anyone else and the only noise you should hear is the birds.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: When the luggage comes, one of the guys will take it across to your cabin for you and make sure you know the way back here to the main centre for dinner in the restaurant.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Dinner will be served in about an hour or so.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: All the times of each day's activities are printed on the blue sheet you should have got in the information guides that were handed out on the coach.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Each Explorer trip has a different focus, so it doesn't matter how many you do or on what day, because there's always something new to discover in the rainforest.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Tomorrow 1 think we've still got places on the Orchid and Fungi Tour.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: This is on foot and takes you to different parts of the rainforest.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Or, if you'd prefer, there's the Four- Wheel-Drive tour to the waterfalls, or the fishing trip where I promise you we'll catch some lunch, and last but not least, the famous Crocodile Cruise that leaves at 11 am each day. (Just in time for the crocodile's lunch!) Plenty to choose from here at Rainforest Lodge or just sit on your balcony, relax and unwind and enjoy the views.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: In the evenings there is the Spotlight Tour, one of my favourites.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: The Spotlight Tour leaves at sundown and lets you catch a glimpse of some more of the rainforest's wildlife as it comes out at dusk to feed.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: That's a great trip and if you can, I'd really try to make sure you do it during your stay.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: You've chosen to visit the rainforest in March, which is just at the end of the wet season, so you'll soon notice how well the waterfalls are running and also how damp the ground is.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Things can tend to get a bit slippery, too, so if you didn't bring any walking boots I'd advise you to hire some from the office.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: You'll also be much better off in long trousers rather than shorts because they will give your legs more protection, and socks are a good idea too.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: There's no need to be nervous of the rainforest provided that you treat it with respect and common sense.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Most of the animals and wildlife are gentle and harmless.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: There are some venomous snakes to beware of, but really they're much more frightened of you than you are of them.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: The other thing is that certain plants can cause irritation if you touch them with bare skin.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: Well, that's about all for the time being.

segments.speaker: RECREATION OFFICER
segments.en: The guys are here to take you and your luggage to the cabins . . .
